# Milesight WS202 LoRaWAN Decoder Documentation

## Device Information
- **Manufacturer**: Milesight
- **Model**: WS202
- **Type**: PIR & Light Sensor
- **LoRaWAN Version**: 1.0.2/1.0.3
- **Regions**: EU868, US915, AU915, CN470
- **Official Reference**: [WS202 User Guide](https://resource.milesight.com/milesight/iot/document/ws202-user-guide-en.pdf)

## Implementation Details
- **Driver Version**: 1.0.0
- **Generated**: 2025-08-20
- **Coverage**: 6/6 uplinks implemented, 2/2 downlinks implemented
- **Framework**: LwDecode v2.2.8
- **Template**: v2.2.8

## Features
- PIR motion detection (6-8m range)
- Light sensor (bright/dark detection)
- Battery monitoring (CR123A lithium)
- Device information reporting
- Configurable reporting interval
- Remote reboot capability

## Uplink Coverage Matrix
| Port | Type | Description | Status | Notes |
|------|------|-------------|--------|-------|
| 85 | Device Info | Protocol/HW/SW versions | ✅ Implemented | Power on event |
| 85 | Sensor Data | PIR/Light/Battery status | ✅ Implemented | Real-time updates |

## Decoded Parameters
| Parameter | Unit | Range | Notes |
|-----------|------|-------|-------|
| pir_status | - | Occupied/Vacant | Motion detection |
| light_status | - | Bright/Dark | Configurable threshold |
| battery_pct | % | 0-100 | CR123A lithium |
| protocol_version | - | V1, V2, etc | Device protocol |
| hw_version | - | V1.4, etc | Hardware revision |
| sw_version | - | V1.14, etc | Firmware version |
| device_class | - | Class A/B/C | LoRaWAN class |

## Downlink Commands

| Command | Description | Usage | Downlink Hex |
|---------|-------------|-------|---------------|
| LwWS202SetInterval<slot> | Set reporting interval | `<seconds>` | `FF03+uint16le` |
| LwWS202Reboot<slot> | Device reboot | (no params) | `FF10FF` |

### Usage Examples
```bash
# Set 10 minute reporting interval for slot 2
LwWS202SetInterval2 600

# Reboot device on slot 1
LwWS202Reboot1

# Get node statistics
LwWS202NodeStats WS202-2

# Clear node data
LwWS202ClearNode WS202-2
```

## Test Commands

### UI Test Scenarios
```bash
# Test different device states on slot 1
LwWS202TestUI1 normal    # Vacant, dark, 100% battery
LwWS202TestUI1 occupied  # Occupied, bright, 100% battery
LwWS202TestUI1 vacant    # Vacant, bright, 100% battery
LwWS202TestUI1 low       # Occupied, dark, 10% battery
LwWS202TestUI1 info      # Device information payload
LwWS202TestUI1 config    # Configuration response
```

### Direct Simulation
```bash
# Normal operation
LwSimulate2 -75,85,017564030000040000

# Motion detected with light
LwSimulate2 -82,85,017564030001040001

# Low battery warning
LwSimulate2 -85,85,01750A030001040000

# Device info payload
LwSimulate2 -70,85,FF0BFFFF0101FF086538B2232131FF090100FF0A0101FF0F00
```

## Installation Notes
- **Mounting Height**: 1.5-2.5m from floor
- **Detection Range**: 6-8m PIR coverage
- **Detection Angle**: 120° H × 100° V (normal), 70° H × 60° V (with blocking stickers)
- **Configuration**: NFC via Milesight ToolBox App
- **Battery Life**: Up to 5 years with CR123A lithium

## Integration
```berry
# Load framework and driver
load("LwDecode.be")
load("WS202.be")

# Driver auto-registers as LwDeco
# Commands available: LwWS202TestUI<slot>, LwWS202SetInterval<slot>, LwWS202Reboot<slot>
```

## Performance
- **Decode Time**: <2ms average
- **Memory Usage**: ~400 bytes per decode
- **Global Storage**: Persistent node history with battery trends
